in_arabic.name: سمعان

data.cultural_impact: The name Simaan holds a significant cultural importance in the Islamic community as it is believed to be a divine name given by Allah (God) for protection and security. Naming a child Simaan is a way for parents to seek blessings from Allah for the safety and well-being of their child. In Islamic communities, having children with protective names is considered a way to ward off harmful influences and to seek Allah's protection.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Simaan holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims. The belief is that by bestowing such a name, the child is granted a special kind of protection and blessings from Allah. Simaan is considered a name that embodies the principles of faith and trust in Allah. It is a reminder to parents and the child that Allah is the greatest protector and that with faith and submission to Him, one can find peace and security in this world and the next. In Islamic tradition, the name Simaan is also believed to have a connection to the prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), as he was protected from harm by Allah in various ways throughout his life. Therefore, carrying this name can also be seen as a connection to the prophets and the spiritual legacy of Islam.
